ghidra: read-only; this worker made no Ghidra mutation

answer.which_nodes: The hull body's collision shapes come from the model's collision-record list at model+4Ch, restricted to records whose owning node is one of four: the node named firstnode (00D1968C), the node pointer at model+0Ch, the node named front (00D196A0) or the node named back (00D19698). The fizika_%02d and hajobelso node walks in the same function produce no hull shape at all.
answer.what_each_contributes: One 48h-byte Dyn shape descriptor of type 4, Dyn::ConvexMeshShape (00C57F50, vtable 00D7A0AC). Not a box, not a capsule. The rotation is the identity from the default record 00931A10 stamps and the translation is the record's float3 at record+14h.
answer.how_attached: Dyn::World::CreateBody walks desc+78h/desc+7Ch and calls 00C5C940 with the descriptor in ECX and the body in EDX (00C5D8D4). 00C5C940 allocates for the type and links the shape at B+70h through shape+208h.
answer.aabb: Per shape 00C57C40 takes the convex mesh's local box at mesh+18h..+2Ch, expands it by the double 0.02 at 00D7A2F8, halves it against 0.5 at 00D7A280, pushes the centre through the shape's 4x3 and the half extent through its magnitudes, and stores shape+0Ch/shape+18h. Per body 00C55FC0 seeds B+38h from 00D7A248 and B+44h from 00D7A244 and merges both corners of every shape into both ends.
answer.to_inertia: 00C31F90 returns B+38h as the minimum and B+44h as the maximum (RET 8), so the extent 00939A8E squares is max - min per axis, and the inertia is mul * (Mass/12) * the extent sums as docs/SHIP_HULL_BODY.md records.
answer.centre_of_mass: None is computed. Nothing in 00937D3F..009399BF or in 00C5C940, 00C57C40 or 00C55FC0 writes a centre of mass; the box inertia is taken about the body origin whatever the AABB's centre is.

routines.name: Dyn_Body_AttachShapeFromDescriptor
routines.abi: __fastcall(ECX = shape descriptor, EDX = body), RET, new shape in EAX
routines.coverage: complete for the dispatch, the intrusive list link and the two tail calls. The sphere, box, cylinder and terrain constructors are identified by the vtable they install; their bodies past that store are unread.
routines.reconstruction: contract only; the shape objects are not reconstructed storage

routines.name: Dyn_ConvexMeshShape_Construct
routines.abi: __thiscall(ECX = body, Shape* self, const ShapeDesc* desc), RET 8 at 00C57FE6
routines.coverage: complete: every field it writes is attributed to a descriptor field
routines.reconstruction: contract only; it settles the descriptor layout

routines.name: Dyn_ConvexMeshShape_vslot0
routines.abi: __thiscall(shape), RET, no stack arguments; slot 0 of vtable 00D7A0AC
routines.coverage: complete for 00C57C40..00C57F37; the tail hop into 00C55FC0 is modelled as a separate call

routines.name: Dyn_Body_RecomputeLocalAABB
routines.abi: body in ESI, no stack arguments, RET
routines.coverage: partial: 00C55FC0..00C5617C projected; 00C56182..00C56441, the broad-phase proxy refresh gated on B+50h bit 3, read and described but not reconstructed (docs/DYN_COLLISION_PASS.md covers the same math at 00C5715C)

routines.name: BSP_DynShapeDescVector_ResizeWithDefault
routines.abi: __thiscall(vector), one stack argument (the new size), tail call 00931610
routines.coverage: partial: only the 48h-byte prototype at 00931A18..00931A8C; the resize and 00931610 are ordinary vector growth and are not reconstructed

routines.name: BSP_UnitController_BuildSubObjectsAndHullBody
routines.coverage: partial, and NOT annotated: 00937C90 is leased to cc_exe_2r. 00938F61..009399BF (the hull collision-record walk, the shape fill loop and the periscope block) is projected as a sequence over a host. 00937D3F..00938F60 (the displacement sum, the rope collection, the health vector and the twenty-slot fizika_%02d part loop) is read and its destinations attributed but only its shape-relevant conclusion is reconstructed. 00939C06..00939C8F is untouched.

host_steps.step: find the model node named "front" -> controller+370h
host_steps.method: model_find_node_by_name; __thiscall(model, const char*), string 00D196A0. Codex owns the model routines; contract only.

host_steps.step: find the model node named "back" -> controller+374h
host_steps.method: model_find_node_by_name; string 00D19698.

host_steps.step: collect every node named "hajobelso"
host_steps.method: __thiscall(model, out_vector*, const char*), string 00CEB8F4. Walks the model's name index at model+7Ch. Not a shape source.

host_steps.step: hide one hajobelso node
host_steps.method: BSP_SceneNode_SetVisibilityFactor(node, 0.0f, 0).

host_steps.step: read one hajobelso node's local position
host_steps.method: BSP_Node_CopyLocalPosition; each component then gets +100000.0 (00CF81F0).

host_steps.step: move that node out of the world
host_steps.method: indirect: node vtable slot 2Ch with the shifted float3. Recorded as indirect; the callee was not read.

host_steps.step: find the model node named "firstnode"
host_steps.method: model_find_node_by_name; string 00D1968C. Returns null when absent, and the comparison at 00939026 is then a plain null test.

host_steps.step: clear the hull collision-record vector at controller+30h
host_steps.method: BSP_UnitController_NodePtrVector_Resize(controller+30h, 0, 0).

host_steps.step: read the model's own node pointer at model+0Ch
host_steps.method: MOV ECX,[ECX+0Ch]: not a call, the fourth owner the walk compares against. Its producer is the model loader, unread.

host_steps.step: push a matched record's +0Ch into controller+30h, reallocating arm
host_steps.method: BSP_UnitController_NodePtrVector_InsertOne. The non-reallocating arm is the inline store at 009390C9.

host_steps.step: resize the 48h-byte shape-descriptor vector
host_steps.method: BSP_DynShapeDescVector_ResizeWithDefault to hull nodes + controller+330h groups. Its prototype supplies the type 4 and the identity rotation.

host_steps.step: game settings singleton for the shape friction
host_steps.method: BSP_GameSettings_GetSingleton; the friction is settings+514h + material*38h, loaded at 00939365 and stored to desc+04h at 00939370.

host_steps.step: vehicle class category for the collision mask
host_steps.method: indirect: class vtable slot 1Ch with the class from unit+538h in ECX. The jump table is at 00939C90; the callee was not read, so the id stays raw.

host_steps.step: grow the body descriptor's shape-pointer vector
host_steps.method: operator new for capacity*2+2 pointers (00939628); the old block is freed at 0093967D and the entry stored at 009396A1.

host_steps.step: find the model node named "periszkop"
host_steps.method: model_find_node_by_name; string 00D0C1F0. The periscope shape needs it plus class+510h <= 0 and class+514h <= 0.

host_steps.step: read the periscope node's local matrix
host_steps.method: BSP_Node_GetLocalMatrix.

host_steps.step: copy that matrix into the periscope descriptor's transform
host_steps.method: 4x4 to 4x3; the destination LEA ECX,[ESP+1D4h] is taken after the PUSH EAX, so it is desc+18h.

host_steps.step: grow the shape-pointer vector for the periscope entry
host_steps.method: same growth as 0093963B; the entry is stored at 009399B6.

host_steps.step: create the body from the descriptor
host_steps.method: Dyn_World_CreateBody. docs/SHIP_HULL_BODY.md owns this step; listed because it is what consumes the shape vector.

host_steps.step: attach one shape descriptor to the new body
host_steps.method: ECX = *ESI, one entry of desc+78h; EDX = EDI, the body. The loop bound is LEA ECX,[EAX+EDX*4] at 00C5D8C8, so desc+7Ch is a count.

host_steps.step: allocate a convex mesh shape from the pool
host_steps.method: critical-section-guarded fixed-size pool over operator new(10D04h) blocks; the element size is not visible here.

host_steps.step: construct the convex mesh shape
host_steps.method: PUSH EDI (desc), PUSH EAX (shape), MOV ECX,ESI (body); RET 8.

host_steps.step: fill the shape's own AABB
host_steps.method: ECX = the new shape. Writes shape+0Ch and shape+18h.

host_steps.step: magnitude of one basis element
host_steps.method: BSP_Math_AbsFloat, the first of nine; the others at 00C57DE6, 00C57DF7, 00C57E07, 00C57E17, 00C57E27, 00C57E37, 00C57E47, 00C57E57.

host_steps.step: recompute the body AABB after the shape's bounds
host_steps.method: ESI = shape+04h, the body 00C57F7C stored.

host_steps.step: recompute the body AABB after the link
host_steps.method: ESI still the body argument from 00C5C961.

host_steps.step: add the body to the broad phase on its first shape
host_steps.method: only when [body+70h] was null before the attach (EBP from 00C5C963); the argument is [[body]+444h]. The callee was not read.

host_steps.step: read the body AABB back for the inertia
host_steps.method: __thiscall(body, float3* out_min, float3* out_max), RET 8; copies B+38h..+40h then B+44h..+4Ch. Confirms extent = max - min.

model_data.conclusion: Owners 1, 3 and 4 resolve to null for this model, so its hull shapes are exactly the records owned by the node at model+0Ch; the hajobelso loop and the periscope block do nothing.
model_data.not_read: The numeric extent of the DeRuyter's `body` convex object, and therefore its exact inertia. It needs the ConvexObject chunk payload and the model loader that writes model+4Ch and model+0Ch, both Codex's packets.
model_data.tree_scan: 196 of the models/ships tree carry at least one of these names; periszkop only on I-54, I-56, I-58, i-400, kaiten, minisub, type7, type_b.
